svg.text: master inverter, pass gate, slave feedback
F07 library flip-flop dffq_1 (DUT1, and the early observer): the paper's "regular library FF"
Master: a clocked inverter takes D into net4; inverter net4 -> net0 and a clocked inverter back into net4 close the loop
(this loop is what goes metastable). On the clock edge the pass gate tn9/tp7 hands net0 to the slave (net2 -> net3); Q = NOT net3.
Rails: VDD at the top, VSS at the bottom; every PMOS body is on VDD and every NMOS body on VSS (drawn inside the symbol). A dot marks a connection; wires that cross without a dot are not connected.
